newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson to sell units to Flextronics.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson to sell units to Flextronics.

text.p: Swedish telecoms company LM Ericsson said it signed a declaration of intent for the sale of its production units at Verko and Vedeby in Karlskrona, Sweden, to Flextronics International based in San Jose, California.
Ericsson gave no financial details of the deal but said the Karlskrona units manufactured systems for company communication systems and for portable telephony.
It said the outsourcing of production was in line with Ericsson's strategy of focusing on its core activity of delivering communications solutions.
Ericsson quoted Michael Marks, Flextronics chairman and managing director, as saying Karlskrona would become the centre of its European operations.
Flextronics has production plants also in the U.S., Britain, Hong Kong, China, Malaysia and Singapore.
